_: Web copy per topic, keyed by the Firestore program id. 'title' is the short name (cards, breadcrumbs); 'h1' is the search phrase; 'intro' is the 2-sentence web-only intro. reviewed:false = a draft nobody has signed off yet. A topic missing here falls back to its app title, cleaned up.

movelib_rotisseries.title: Rotisseries
movelib_rotisseries.intro: The follower turns while traveling all the way around the leader. Start with the easiest versions below, then try it from shadow, from a cambré, or as a half rotisserie.

movelib_madrid-steps.title: Madrid steps
movelib_madrid-steps.intro: The Madrid step is a side-by-side footwork pattern that breaks out of the basic. Start with the plain step, then take it into shadow, into other moves, or add follower styling.

movelib_clock-turns.title: Clock turns
movelib_clock-turns.intro: The follower travels a full circle around the leader, who turns on the spot. Different ways in, doubles and fake-outs, and longer sequences.
